findings.note: The admin client is created with the service role key in a client component.
The service role key has a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name, so it ships to the browser.
The server fetches any URL from the query string.
The Stripe webhook trusts the request body without checking the signature.
The Stripe secret key has a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name; the publishable key was meant.
The projects table has no row level security.
The sign-in callback redirects to any URL in ?next=.
